name: Hive Census — deterministic machine census, no model
summary: Emit this box's census as deterministic static JSON — protocol revision, anchor hash, resident populations, posture, trust — computed from local filesystem and git facts with NO language-model call. Byte-stable for the same inputs, sorted and string-valued so it drops straight into a rapp/1 frame payload and two boxes computing the same census produce the same hash. Counts things, never names them.
tagline: Facts already on disk. Byte-stable, hashable, produced without a language model.
author: RapterBox
